$comment: The chart's values (draft-07): additionalProperties false, with a global escape. A stateless HTTP/2 to NATS bridge, chart-only, without CRD or operator; the config surface mirrors internal/config/config.go.
title: sbi-ha-gateway Helm values

replicaCount.description: Number of gateway pods. Stateless; NATS queue-group shares load.

image.description: Container image. Platform/publish concern — not operator-tunable. §8.1: registry must be allowlisted (no scheme, private IP or localhost); the tag defaults to the chart appVersion, never latest.

resources.description: Pod resource requests/limits. Participates in service-level sizing.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Time the kubelet allows the gateway after SIGTERM. Must exceed config.shutdown.drainDelay plus config.shutdown.timeout.

config.description: Application configuration (rendered to env; mirrors internal/config/config.go).

auth.description: /metrics and /admin/* require a bearer token. false is an explicit opt-out (a WARN and sbi_gateway_security_protection{protection="admin_auth"} 0 say so). A high-risk security change.

tokenSecret.description: Secret holding the bearer token. Empty: the chart creates <fullname>-admin-token with a random token.

tokenKey.description: Key of the token in tokenSecret.

tls.description: Serve the admin port with tls.existingSecret's certificate; the probes use HTTPS. false is an explicit opt-out; a trial install without TLS switches it off itself. A high-risk security change.

url.description: URL of the NATS the applications use. Empty: the chart deploys its own core NATS (nats.deploy) for a trial install, which no application is connected to; required when nats.deploy is false. Changing it rolls the pods.

secret.description: Credentials and TLS for config.nats.url, from a Secret the operator provides, mounted read-only at /etc/sbi-gateway/nats. Name the keys the Secret holds; leave the others empty. One authentication: user with passwordKey, tokenKey, credsKey or nkeySeedKey. TLS: caKey, and certKey with keyKey for a client certificate. The gateway refuses contradicting settings at start-up.

maxRetries.description: Passes over a notification's callback URIs, the first included. Below 1 the gateway does not start.

baseDelay.description: Wait after the first failed pass; doubles after each further one. Must be positive.

workers.description: Notifications delivered at once; one whose network function does not answer holds one. Their order is not kept.

drainDelay.description: After SIGTERM the gateway serves on this long, answering not ready, before it stops listening. Plus timeout, it must stay below terminationGracePeriodSeconds. 0s closes at once.

timeout.description: After the drain delay: the time the requests in flight, the notification deliveries and the SMS being sent have to finish. Plus drainDelay, it must stay below terminationGracePeriodSeconds.

rateLimit.description: Per-client token bucket in front of the back end. rps=0 disables.

tls.description: TLS cert/key file paths (material mounted via tls.existingSecret). Empty ⇒ h2c.

security.description: Secure by default: TLS, client certificates and OAuth are required unless each is switched off explicitly. A trial install (bundled NATS) opts out of what it lacks.

allowPlaintextSbi.description: Serve cleartext h2c without tls.existingSecret. A high-risk security change.

clientAuthMode.description: Inbound client certificates. Default require: needs tls.existingSecret with ca.crt and clientCAFile. Security-critical — approval-gated.

disabled.description: Auth kill switch: true accepts SBI requests without an access token. Default false: set audience and nrfJwksUrl (or jwksFile). A high-risk security change.

audience.description: Expected aud claim (this NF's instance ID).

requireCertBinding.description: RFC 8705 — reject tokens without cnf. Pair with mTLS.

nrf.description: Registration with the NRF (TS 29.510 Nnrf_NFManagement); off while apiRoot is empty. The installation is one NF instance per profile, whatever its replica count: every pod registers the same profile and heartbeats it.

apiRoot.description: The NRF's {apiRoot} (scheme://host[:port][/prefix]); empty: no registration. Needs profiles.

heartbeatTimer.description: Heartbeat interval proposed at registration, whole seconds ("30s"); empty: the NRF's.

notificationApiRoot.description: The {apiRoot} the NRF reaches the SBI port at (https with TLS); set, each pod subscribes to the SMSFs it discovers. Needs the SMS_GMSC profile; empty: no subscription.

profiles.description: One entry per NF type (UDM, UDR, SMS_GMSC): "profile", a TS 29.510 NFProfile (nfInstanceId, nfType, an address, udmInfo/udrInfo, ...), and "service", NFService attributes added to each service registered (none for the SMS_GMSC, which registers no service: the instance MT SMS is sent to the SMSF as, with its access tokens; needs config.sms.enabled). Its SUPI ranges and group decide which subscribers' traffic consumers send here: a high-risk change.

nfInstanceId.description: A UUID version 4 in lower case (TS 29.510 clause 5.2.2.2.2); also in config.oauth.audience, but for the SMS_GMSC's.

deregister.description: The post-delete Job that removes the profiles from the NRF on helm uninstall.

profile.description: Delivery of data-change notifications: sbi_direct POSTs to the callback URI, scef_rest leaves it to an external adapter.

allowedDestinations.description: Hosts callbacks and SMSF calls may reach: host names, .domain suffixes, CIDR blocks, addresses. Empty: none (unless allowAny). Loopback, link-local and multicast addresses only when listed by address.

allowAny.description: Allow callbacks and SMSF calls to any host but loopback, link-local, unspecified and multicast addresses. A high-risk security change.

enabled.description: Opens the SMS surfaces: serving-SMSF lookup and Nsmsf MtForwardSm. Needs config.nats.url: a NATS with JetStream, not the bundled one.

stream.description: The stream created for the SMS when no stream captures sbi.outbound.nsmsf.send.request.

deliveryEventSubject.description: The subject each SMS's DeliveryEvent goes to.

disabled.description: Audit kill switch. Disabling audit is high-risk / approval-gated.

natsSubject.description: Audit event subject; tenant-prefixable for multi-tenant clusters.

extraVolumes.description: Further pod volumes, for files the gateway reads by path (outbound TLS, JWKS file, SMS resolver): usually a Secret or a ConfigMap.

extraVolumeMounts.description: Mounts of extraVolumes in the gateway container; mount them read-only.

networkPolicy.description: Ingress to the gateway pods: the SBI port from sbiFrom (empty: anywhere); the admin port (its token and TLS: config.admin) from pods in the release namespace and adminFrom.

sbiFrom.description: NetworkPolicyPeer entries allowed to reach the SBI port; empty: anywhere.

adminFrom.description: NetworkPolicyPeer entries allowed to reach the admin port besides the release namespace, e.g. Prometheus.

tls.description: TLS secret sourcing. Cert material is a secret reference, never inline.

existingSecret.description: Name of a pre-created Secret (tls.crt/tls.key/ca.crt). Empty ⇒ h2c.

nats.description: Bundled single-replica core NATS, deployed only when config.nats.url is empty. For a trial or smoke install, not for production.

deploy.description: Deploy the bundled NATS when config.nats.url is empty. False: config.nats.url is required.

enabled.description: Render a Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor for the admin port's /metrics (admin token and TLS included).

tlsConfig.description: The ServiceMonitor endpoint's tlsConfig, with config.admin.tls.

enabled.description: Render a PrometheusRule with the gateway's alerts; they select the series the chart's ServiceMonitor scrapes.
